commenti.body: There isn't much to it, story-wise. The main attraction is seeing a little boy actually grow up right in front of you. It's like the coolest special effect ever. I liked it, but I'm not sure if i would tell anyone they *need* to watch it

It was a pretty interesting concept. But it's not a movie that I'd  rewatch. If I was to rewatch a Linklater film it would be Waking Life (my favorite of his - it's an animated film in rotoscope with characters who are bustling with energy to explain their philosophy), Slacker, Dazed and Confused (I just kinda liked it, but it's one of his best received movies), or the Sunrise trilogy.

No. The gimmick was a gimmick. The actual story is pretty lousy. I too can’t remember what it’s about. A family with family stuff going on. Interesting gimmick, boring story. I forgot the story the minute I walked out of the cinema. Patricia Arquette won her career Oscar. If I wanted to watch a family have a boring ordeal, I’d go work 5 seasons at Tweetsie Railroad. It’s so boring and extra. It’s an interesting exercise in filming a movie over multiple years. But the story is truly lacking.

As I watched it I kept thinking without this actor aging what’s the point of this movie? It didn’t really seem to offer anything new IMO. So if you like coming of age movies you may like this but don’t expect to be amazed.

There's not much to remember. It's a slice of life but the slice happens to be multiple slices across multiple formative years. It's interesting because it captures all these little details about the time periods just because it was actually filmed then. It feels like an honest portrayal of what being a boy/teenager/young adult in the 90s/00s felt like, speaking as one of them. But as a narrative it's just "boy does things until he's a man."

Wow this sub really doesn’t have Linklater fans? I loved Boyhood. I think Dazed and Confused, Boyhood and the Before Trilogy are his best movies. You should absolutely watch this movie to understand how life can be slow and fleeting at the same time. Enjoy!
I completely agree. Im also very fond of Everybody Wants Some. Im really hoping for one more movie in that style.

I'm new to this sub but I assumed it was for people who actually have a different taste that isn't that mainstream. But judging by the comments I'm wrong.

Maybe it's because I love stories that are about "nothing". But yes. You should definitely watch the movie.

I hope people on this thread will never read Knausgard.
That one is also great and very underrated!

I hate the film.

But... everyone should watch it.  I'm seemingly the only person that doesn't like the film.

Everyone but me likes the film.  So... odds are VERY HIGH that you'd like the film.

Obviously, we all have personal tastes and there is a lot of subjectivity involved.  I don't know you.

But, again... everyone (except for me) really appreciated the film.

So... I've told multiple people to watch *Boyhood*.  **It's a film both critics and the public almost universally praise**.

Everyone should watch it... and then think I'm an idiot for somehow hating it (which is fine).  I'm glad it exists because it's brought so much pleasure to the world!

Definitely a "must-watch," imo.

(even though I truly do hate the film - but would very much not get into all the reasons why, as it very clearly is an extremely unpopular opinion of mine)
